name: type_inference_test.k
model:
class TypeInferenceTest {
  explicitInt:Int = 42
  explicitString:String = "hello"
  explicitBool:Bool = true
  inferredInt:Int = 100
  inferredString:String = "world"
  inferredBool:Bool = false
  inferredReal:Real = 3.14E0
  inferredSum:Int = explicitInt + 10
  inferredConcat:String = explicitString + " there"

  req inferredInt > 50

  req inferredSum > 100
}
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TypeInferenceTest (mk-TypeInferenceTest (explicitInt Int)(explicitString String)(explicitBool Bool)(inferredInt Int)(inferredString String)(inferredBool Bool)(inferredReal Real)(inferredSum Int)(inferredConcat String)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TypeInferenceTest (sel-TypeInferenceTest TypeInferenceTest))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TypeInferenceTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TypeInferenceTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TypeInferenceTest ((this Ref)) TypeInferenceTest
  (sel-TypeInferenceTest (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TypeInferenceTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TypeInferenceTest this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

;   Getters for class TypeInferenceTest:
; ----------------------------------------

; --- getters for TypeInferenceTest.explicitInt: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest!explicitInt ((this Ref)) Int
  (explicitInt (deref-TypeInferenceTest this))
)

; --- getters for TypeInferenceTest.explicitString: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest!explicitString ((this Ref)) String
  (explicitString (deref-TypeInferenceTest this))
)

; --- getters for TypeInferenceTest.explicitBool: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest!explicitBool ((this Ref)) Bool
  (explicitBool (deref-TypeInferenceTest this))

  (inferredInt (deref-TypeInferenceTest this))

  (inferredString (deref-TypeInferenceTest this))
)

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest!inferredBool ((this Ref)) Bool
  (inferredBool (deref-TypeInferenceTest this))
)

; --- getters for TypeInferenceTest.inferredReal: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest!inferredReal ((this Ref)) Real
  (inferredReal (deref-TypeInferenceTest this))
)

; --- getters for TypeInferenceTest.inferredSum: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest!inferredSum ((this Ref)) Int
  (inferredSum (deref-TypeInferenceTest this))
)

  (inferredConcat (deref-TypeInferenceTest this))

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===

; ------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TypeInferenceTest:

(declare-const const-1-TypeInferenceTest TypeInferenceTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeInferenceTest!explicitInt this) 42)
)

(assert (! (TypeInferenceTest.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeInferenceTest!explicitString this) "hello")
)

(assert (! (TypeInferenceTest.inv2 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeInferenceTest!explicitBool this) true)
)

(assert (! (TypeInferenceTest.inv3 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeInferenceTest!inferredInt this) 100)
)

(assert (! (TypeInferenceTest.inv4 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeInferenceTest!inferredString this) "world")

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeInferenceTest!inferredBool this) false)

(assert (! (TypeInferenceTest.inv6 1) :named _xkassert5))

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeInferenceTest!inferredReal this) 3.1400000000000000)

(assert (! (TypeInferenceTest.inv7 1) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 8: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv8 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeInferenceTest!inferredSum this) (+ (TypeInferenceTest!explicitInt this) 10))

(assert (! (TypeInferenceTest.inv8 1) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 9: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv9 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TypeInferenceTest!inferredConcat this) (str.++ (TypeInferenceTest!explicitString this) " there"))
)

(assert (! (TypeInferenceTest.inv9 1) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 10: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv10 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (TypeInferenceTest!inferredInt this) 50)
)

(assert (! (TypeInferenceTest.inv10 1) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 11: ---

(define-fun TypeInferenceTest.inv11 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (TypeInferenceTest!inferredSum this) 100)
)

(assert (! (TypeInferenceTest.inv11 1) :named _xkassert10))

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-TypeInferenceTest const-1-TypeInferenceTest))

(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (> (inferredInt (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) 50))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (= (explicitInt (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) 42))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (explicitInt (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) 10)))
  (= (inferredSum (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (= (explicitBool (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) true))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (inferredBool (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) false))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (explicitString (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) "hello"))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (str.++ (explicitString (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1)))
                   " there")))
  (= (inferredConcat (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (inferredReal (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) (/ 157.0 50.0)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (> (inferredSum (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
       1
       (lift-TypeInferenceTest
         (mk-TypeInferenceTest
           91
           "hello"
           true
           100
           "world"
           false
           (/ 157.0 50.0)
           101
           "hello there"))))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (= (inferredInt (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun const-1-TypeInferenceTest () TypeInferenceTest
  (mk-TypeInferenceTest
  91
  "hello"
  true
  100
  "world"
  false
  (/ 157.0 50.0)
  101
  "hello there"))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (inferredString (sel-TypeInferenceTest (select heap 1))) "world"))
